create.name: The Yoga Flat
create.bio:
The Yoga Flat is a Copenhagen yoga studio and teacher-training school with three rooms in the city, in Christianshavn, Vesterbro and Nørrebro. It was set up by a brother and sister, Nicolai and Sarah Emilie Boas, who still run it together and lead its trainings alongside the meditation teacher Cédric Gorinas. Sarah Emilie's own teaching leans towards breath and meditation within flowing practice shaped by Anusara, while Nicolai brings a close interest in anatomy and body awareness. Classes run in English and Danish, in the studios and by livestream, from gentle and yin sessions to stronger flow, with evening meditation and regular kirtan evenings of call-and-response mantra chanting.

The school's main programme is a Yoga Alliance-registered 200-hour training held over eight weekends, built on vinyasa and hatha with alignment, and giving real time to pranayama, a personal meditation practice, the subtle body and philosophy read from both classical and nondual tantric sources. Graduates can go on to a 300-hour advanced course that opens with a residential week on the Zealand coast, and there is a shorter 50-hour course in seated meditation and pranayama that draws on the Yoga Sutras and the Bhagavad Gita. The studio also runs trainings abroad and a wider timetable of movement classes.

courses.title: 200-Hour Yoga Teacher Training w. Sarah Emilie, Nicolai & Cédric
courses.description: The school's foundation training, taught in person over eight full weekends in Copenhagen. It blends vinyasa and hatha practice with anatomy, philosophy from classical and nondual tantric sources, the subtle body, pranayama and a daily meditation practice, alongside teaching method and sequencing.

courses.title: 300-Hour Advanced Yoga Teacher Training
courses.description: An advanced course for qualified teachers that opens with a week living in at Gudmindrup on the coast, then continues through the year with modules on philosophy and its texts, a steady meditation and breath practice, refined asana technique, mentoring and self-inquiry, and teaching retreats and private sessions.
courses.price: 32.800 DKK ex moms (including moms for students above the age of 30 is 41.000 DKK)

courses.title: 50-Hour Meditation & Breath Work Training w. Sarah Emilie & Cédric
courses.description: Two intensive weekends with weekly online sessions in between, centred on seated meditation and pranayama, with study of the Yoga Sutras, nondual tantra and the Bhagavad Gita. Participants keep a daily home practice and design a short series of meditation classes for a continuing-education certificate.
courses.price: 10.000 DKK (including VAT/Moms); 8.000 kr. if you are under 30

flags: Owner check (scope): the studio describes itself as offering 'yoga, breathwork, strength training, pilates & more' and runs many prenatal and pelvic-floor events. Kept because it is a founder-led yoga school whose own 200/300-hour and meditation trainings put philosophy, pranayama and meditation at the centre, with kirtan evenings; it is not lineage-led (Anusara-influenced, vinyasa/hatha).
